Hi Kristen / Helix ops team,

We observed intermittent control-plane delays starting ~07:55 PDT after the private network upgrade in your VPC that rolled through at 07:30. A subset (~3%) of agent connections experienced extended rejoin times (30s-90s) which caused occasional request routing timeouts and a handful of aborted sessions. Impact: short spikes in inference latency and two customer-facing API timeouts between 07:58–08:05.

Quick summary:
- Root cause candidate: MTU mismatch introduced by the new transit config combined with asymmetric routing for some AZs, causing TCP retransmits during agent reconnects.
- Immediate mitigation: we enabled aggressive keepalive and extended socket retry on our side and applied a transient routing fallback that reduced rejoin times to sub-3s for affected agents by 08:45.
- Next steps: we want to coordinate a controlled config tweak in your transit (one small change we recommend) and share logs and a short remediation checklist.

I've attached a small bundle of the agent diagnostics and a set of logs for the window 07:45–09:00 for your team to review. Can we schedule a 30-min call today to walk the changes and confirm the permanent fix?

Subject: Post-incident summary and short-term mitigation completed — Helix Health PrivNet

Hi Kristen and team,

Thanks again for taking the sync last week. This message summarizes what happened, what we changed, and the follow-up actions we committed to.

Incident summary (concise):
- Timeline: 07:30 maintenance transit rollout → 07:55 first agent rejoin failures → 08:45 transient mitigation reduced impact → 10:20 our socket fallback deployed → 11:10 controlled MTU tweak applied in Helix transit (maintenance window) → full normalization by 11:16.
- Impact: short latency spikes for ~3% of agents, two customer API timeouts, no data loss, no unauthorized access.
- Root cause (final): asymmetric path + MTU/PMTU mismatch created intermittent ICMP unreachable responses that caused TCP retransmit storms during agent reconnects.

Actions taken:
- Applied agent-level keepalive and reduced SYN retransmit on our control-plane pool (10:20) — reduced reconnection times to sub-3s.
- Coordinated with Helix to change per-route MTU from 9000 to 8950 in the new transit path during the maintenance window (11:10) — eliminated fragmentation and restored steady-state.
- Added a temporary routing fallback on our side during the window to avoid flip-flop while changes propagated.

Follow-up & commitments:
- Engineering (Evelyn) will prototype PMTU detection and auto-adjust in the agent within the next quarter (EOD target: 2027-01-15 for design doc).
- We will provide a small runbook for Helix ops with the exact commands and verification steps — attached.
- We'll schedule a short post-change validation with Helix next maintenance window (30-min) to confirm no regressions.

Attachments: remediation-checklist-helix-20261013.pdf, helix_ops_logs_20261011.tar.gz, agent-diagnostics-20261011.txt
